Lemma
[existence for cap geometry] Source: kleiner-lott ↗ lem:kl-three-dimensional-solutions-existence-kappa-solutions-5 1. Lemma 10\group Kleiner–Lott Singularities and Surgery

If some $x\in C$ has an $\epsilon $-cap neighborhood $B_x$ as in Lemma 4, then $C$ is a capped $\epsilon $-horn.
